workstream: A6 in-app notices (FR-12) and audit and corrections (FR-26)
dataKind: synthetic only; no outbound delivery, no real recipients, paid AI and real provider settings disabled
meaning: pass = expected results checked by the named automated suites or procedure on this branch; partial = part checked, gap named; blocked = needs people, devices or a policy decision not provided; not-run = steps not executed here. Nothing is marked accepted; all designed cases remain unapproved.

guardedRun.command: node scripts/test.mjs static unit integration smoke --fast --guard
guardedRun.regressionGuard: 53 baselined suites checked, 0 excused; the two new suites are not in tests/regression-baseline.json yet (the owner of the baseline adds them)

mountedRun.environment: built Worker from this branch on 127.0.0.1:8806, isolated local D1, synthetic fixture, Chromium, every non-local request aborted and counted

existingMountedChecksRerun.worker-family-ui-check: 36 of 36 procedures passed, 0 external requests, 0 page errors
existingMountedChecksRerun.worker-domain-check: 104 passed in one of two final runs; the other run, and an earlier run, stopped on an HTTP 503 'worker restarted mid-request' on unrelated POST routes

sandboxNote: The shared local sandbox restarts the Worker under roughly one request in seven in rapid POST loops (probe: 22 of 160 POSTs as a guardian to /api/courses, /api/classes, /api/report-cards and /api/notifications returned 503 'Your worker restarted mid-request'); another workstream saw the same on an unrelated PATCH. It does not depend on the notices and audit code. The notices and audit browser harness repeats such requests (bounded) and reports the count.
